systems.owner: Agence Nationale des Infrastructures Numériques et des Fréquences (ANINF)
systems.tiers: One office in Franceville, Haut-Ogooué, opened June 2026 (reported 24 June 2026), the agency's first outside the capital since its creation in 2011; to give technical support to local administrations and help them use and manage 'government digital infrastructure'
Named without description; local administrations in the province are to be assisted in using it

note: The opening of a national agency's field office, attended by the mayor of Franceville and the president of the M'Passa departmental council; the article says what the office will do for local administrations but does not state that any local government office is connected or to what.
